## AI-slop risk check

- [ ] No invented product requirements.
- [ ] No fake APIs, fake docs, fake tests, or fake config assumptions.
- [ ] No broad rewrite where a targeted change would suffice.
- [ ] No stale documentation left in a canonical location.
- [ ] Generated prose was reviewed for factual accuracy.
- [ ] Tests assert real behavior rather than merely encoding the agent's assumptions.

## Documentation migration

- [ ] Canonical docs updated.
- [ ] Stale docs archived, deleted, or marked superseded.
- [ ] Cross-links updated.
- [ ] Plans and trackers updated.
- [ ] Future agents can identify the current source of truth.
